about: Settings' Oxy account (docs/adr/0020-oxy-account-login.mdx, decision 5; apps/settings): at the top of the sidebar, as a Mac's Apple Account, the machine's Oxy session as the platform tells Settings (its session host, over a played accounts' service): the account's picture (its initials, without one) and name; its page with the name, the handle, Sign Out… and Remove from This Computer…, each confirmed first. Cancelling asks nothing; removing, confirmed, asks the accounts' service (Settings alone may), which then ends the account's sessions.
